row.title: RUNWAY-1: the system measures how many days it can run with nobody there
row.body: Owner target 2026-11-20: run unattended for at least one year. doctrine/runway.json declares every calendar deadline (domains, the lane token, the Cloudflare deploy token, runtimes, the runner image, D1 size) with a live probe, a consequence and a remedy; foundation/runway.py measures them and the daily watchdog pass (foundation/resilience.py main) records the reading and files Q-RUNWAY items. First reading: 354 days, bounded by the four domains expiring 2027-11-10 with auto-renew off; Node 22 loses security fixes on 2027-04-30. The two Cloudflare deadlines were unmeasured from a session and are measured by the watchdog, which holds the token.
